description: Retrieves summarized event statistics for a Sentry organization, aggregated by project, allowing queries for event counts or unique occurrences over a specified time period and resolution, with filtering by project, category, and outcome.

category.description: Filter by event category. If 'attachment', other categories cannot be included. If 'error', `default` and `security` are also included.
category.title: CategoryEnm

download.description: If true, triggers a CSV download of the response; otherwise JSON.
download.title: Download

end.description: Inclusive end of the time series range (UTC ISO8601 datetime string or Unix timestamp). Use with `start` instead of `statsPeriod`.
end.title: End

field.description:
Aggregation field for event counts. Interpretation depends on event type:
`sum(quantity)`: For attachments, total size in bytes. For sessions, total events within sessions. For others, event count.
`sum(times_seen)`: Sum of unique occurrences. For sessions, count of unique sessions. For attachments, total attachments.
field.title: Field

interval.description: Time series resolution (e.g., `1h`). Default is `1h`. Minimum `1h`. Intervals must cleanly divide one day and cannot exceed `1d`.
interval.title: Interval

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the Sentry organization.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

outcome.description: Filter by event outcome status (e.g., accepted, filtered, rate-limited).
outcome.title: OutcomeEnm

project.description: List of project IDs (strings or integers) to filter by. Omit or use empty list for all projects.
project.title: Project

reason.description: Reason an event was filtered or dropped (e.g., `project_quota`, `invalid_origin`).
reason.title: Reason

start.description: Start of the time series range (UTC ISO8601 datetime string or Unix timestamp). Use with `end` instead of `statsPeriod`.
start.title: Start

statsPeriod.description: Relative time series range (e.g., `1d`, `2h`). Units: `m`, `h`, `d`, `w`. Use instead of `start` and `end`. Defaults to `24h` if no time range is specified.
statsPeriod.title: Stats Period

name: get_organization_stats_summary

end.description: End time of the statistics period in ISO 8601 format (UTC)
end.title: End

projects.description: List of project-level statistics. Each project contains aggregated event counts, times seen, and metadata for the requested time period.
projects.title: Projects

start.description: Start time of the statistics period in ISO 8601 format (UTC)
start.title: Start

abuse.description: Number of events marked as abuse
abuse.title: Abuse

cardinality_limited.description: Number of events limited by cardinality
cardinality_limited.title: Cardinality Limited

client_discard.description: Number of events discarded by client
client_discard.title: Client Discard

StatsItem.description: Statistics for a specific event category
StatsItem.title: StatsItem
